name: PS4: Load GoldHEN (wake → wait → send goldhen.bin)
description: Wake the PS4, wait 8 seconds for a manually enabled BIN loader, send goldhen.bin to TCP 9020, then verify the payload-sender port stayed open.
notes: PS4 takes longer than PS5 to open the GoldHEN exploit listener, so the port check retries the wake + wait pair. Requires your own compatible goldhen.bin (and ftp_server.bin for the FTP template). These templates cannot bootstrap a jailbreak from a closed BIN-loader port.

steps.name: Check GoldHEN port 9020 (retry wake on fail)

name: PS5: Guide loader → kstuff → ShadowMount → zftpd
description: When the PS5 is online and its ELF loader is closed: open the configured guide loader, wait for port 9021, send kstuff, ShadowMountPlus and zftpd, then verify FTP.
notes: PS5 only. Configure the User Guide host and calibrate both guide scripts for its prompts and selected action first. The watcher runs only while the console is online and the loader remains closed. A failed port check reruns the guide steps at most twice, then reports failure; it never reports success merely because the button script completed.

steps.name: Wait for ELF loader; retry guide at most twice
